name: JPEG Quality Reduction
summary: Discards high-frequency visual details that human eyes cannot easily distinguish, shrinking photos by 50-80%.
analogy: Smoothing subtle texture variations in the background of a painting so it takes fewer brushstrokes to describe.
what_you_gain: Massive 50-80% file size reduction for photographs with minimal visible quality degradation.
what_you_lose: Irreversible loss of subtle pixel gradients and fine textures; repeated re-encoding causes compression artifacts.
best_for: Everyday photo collections, web asset bundling, and image-heavy project archives.
avoid_for: Screenshots with fine text, pixel art, medical imaging, or archival photography.
go_deeper: Converts RGB to YCbCr chroma-subsampled planes, computes 8x8 Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), and quantizes high-frequency coefficients.
